sites.why: rule 1: legacy completions (openai.completions.create, completion='completions' mode) has no Router endpoint; also rule 2 (HF router base URL).

Streaming chat.completions in the main endpoint. rule 2: client baseURL is OPENAI_BASE_URL, which the shipped .env (and the code fallback in router/endpoint.ts) set to Hugging Face's inference router https://router.huggingface.co/v1, a non-OpenAI host; model ids are HF Hub ids discovered at runtime from ${OPENAI_BASE_URL}/models (optionally suffixed :provider).
